properties.decision: Verification gains an OPTIONAL criterion — what the check was measured against. A `failing` carrying one is reported as a MEASUREMENT; a `failing` without one is reported as a bar never stated, and is never presented as though a threshold existed. Nothing is refused and no existing check breaks.
properties.name: A failing check may state what it fell short of; where it does not, the report says the bar was never stated
properties.rationale:
Anthony's call, 2026-08-01, from three options. THE PROBLEM, from the music_graph adopt pass (BL-143): that repo's central fact is that everything runs and almost nothing is correct. A smoke run was recorded `passing` (it truly does run) and an accuracy measurement `failing` — but nothing in the repo states an acceptance threshold, so `failing` was the reporter's judgement stored as if it were data. Their words, and the caveat went into a description where no detector reads it.

WHY OPTIONAL RATHER THAN REQUIRED. Option (b), refusing `failing` without a criterion, is the strongest version and was rejected on two counts: it breaks every existing failing check until someone supplies a bar retroactively, and it blocks the honest case where something is plainly broken and no threshold was ever written down. More importantly it is OUT OF STEP WITH THE FAMILY. BL-106, BL-126 and BL-136 all REPORT the gap rather than refusing the work — an unscoped check is counted as unscoped, an undated one as unknown, a consumed one as consumed, and none of them is forbidden. This is the fourth axis and it should behave like the other three.

WHY NOT A NEW STATUS. Option (c), adding `inconclusive`, is the cheapest and gives 'it runs but correctness is unknown' a home — but it treats the symptom. Someone can still write `failing` as a pure opinion and nothing notices, which is the exact defect. It is not foreclosed and could still be added later for its own reasons; it simply does not answer this question.

THE SHAPE THIS COMPLETES. The evidence-quality family now has four faces, all asking whether a green or red tick means what a reader will take it to mean: BL-106 a check stale in TIME, BL-126 narrow in INPUT SPACE, BL-136 not INDEPENDENT of what it validates, and this one — no CRITERION, so there is nothing for the evidence to be evidence of. The first three ask how good the evidence is; this asks what it was evidence FOR.

NOT YET BUILT. The shape is settled; the build is BL-143.
